pages.name: Emergency Plumbing
pages.meta_title: Emergency Plumber in Columbia & the Midlands, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Emergency plumbing for homes in Columbia and the Midlands, SC: burst pipes, major leaks, failed water heaters and no-water calls. Call Mr. Plumber at 803-600-4357.
pages.summary: Burst pipes, flooding, no water or no hot water. Call and we'll get a plumber headed your way.
pages.intro_what: Emergency plumbing is the work that can't wait for a convenient day: water where it shouldn't be, no water where it should be, or a failed water heater. Our first job is to stop the damage, then we make a lasting repair.
intro_signs: Water spraying or pouring from a pipe or fitting
Water on the floor, through a ceiling or down a wall
No water at any faucet in the house
Sewage coming back up through a drain
pages.intro_expect: Call 803-600-4357 and tell us what you're seeing. We'll walk you through shutting off the water if it's safe to do so, send a plumber, stop the leak, and explain the repair options before any work starts.

cards.title: Burst & Broken Pipes
cards.desc: A split pipe can put a lot of water into a home very quickly. We stop the flow, cut out the damaged section and replace it with new pipe so the line is solid again.
included: Help locating and closing your main shutoff
Cutting out and replacing the damaged section
Restoring water and checking for further leaks
signs: Water spraying or pouring from a pipe
A sudden drop in water pressure
The sound of running water when nothing is on

cards.title: Major Leaks & Water in the House
cards.desc: When water is pooling on the floor or coming through a ceiling, the source needs to be found fast. We trace the leak, stop it, and repair the line or fixture that failed.
included: Tracing the source of the water
Repairing the failed pipe, valve or fixture
Testing the repair under normal pressure
signs: Water stains spreading on a ceiling or wall
Dripping from light fixtures or vents

cards.title: No Hot Water
cards.desc: A water heater that quits or starts leaking from the tank needs attention right away. We find out why it stopped, repair it when that makes sense, and tell you plainly when it's time to replace it.
included: Diagnosing gas and electric water heaters
Checking burners, elements, thermostats and valves
Shutting down a leaking tank safely
Repair or replacement options explained on site
signs: Water pooling around the base of the tank
Popping, rumbling or a burning smell from the unit

cards.title: No Water to the House
cards.desc: If nothing comes out of any faucet, the problem could be a main line, a valve, or a well pump. We work through the system until we find it and get water flowing again.
included: Checking the main shutoff and supply valves
Testing the well pump and pressure tank on well homes
signs: Sputtering faucets with air in the lines
Water that comes back for a moment, then stops

pages.name: Drain Cleaning & Jetting
pages.meta_title: Drain Cleaning & Hydro Jetting in Columbia, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Kitchen, bathroom and main sewer line drain cleaning, camera inspection and hydro jetting for homes across Columbia and the Midlands, SC. Family owned since 1958.
pages.summary: Fast, thorough clearing for slow and stopped drains, with camera inspection available.
pages.intro_what: Drain cleaning clears the grease, hair, soap and debris that build up inside your pipes. Depending on the clog, we use a cable machine, a camera to see what's inside, or a high-pressure water jet to scour the line clean.
intro_signs: Sinks, tubs or showers that drain slowly
Gurgling sounds from drains or toilets
Water backing up in more than one fixture
Sewer odors inside the house
pages.intro_expect: We start by asking which fixtures are affected, which tells us whether it's a single drain or the main line. We clear the clog, run water to confirm it flows freely, and show you camera footage when we use it.

cards.title: Kitchen Drains
cards.desc: Kitchen lines clog from grease, food scraps and soap that harden inside the pipe. We clear the line from the sink to where it joins the main so the whole run flows again.
included: Clearing the sink drain and trap
signs: Water standing in the sink after use
Dishwasher water backing into the sink
Bad smell coming from the drain

cards.title: Bathroom Drains
cards.desc: Hair and soap scum are the usual cause of slow sinks, tubs and showers. We pull the blockage out and clean the line instead of just pushing it further down.
included: Sink, tub and shower drain clearing
Removing and cleaning stoppers and traps
Flow test on every fixture we touch
signs: Water pooling around your feet in the shower

cards.title: Main Sewer Lines
cards.desc: When several drains back up at once, the clog is usually in the main line that carries everything out to the sewer or septic. We clear it from a cleanout so every fixture drains again.
signs: Several drains backing up at the same time
Water coming up in the tub when the toilet flushes
Gurgling from floor drains or toilets

cards.title: Camera Inspection
cards.desc: A camera on a flexible cable lets us see inside your pipes. It shows exactly where and why a line keeps clogging, so you aren't guessing about the next step.
included: Video inspection of the drain or sewer line
Locating the problem spot and its depth
Recommendations based on what we see
signs: Suspected roots or a broken pipe

cards.title: Hydro Jetting
cards.desc: Hydro jetting sends high-pressure water through the pipe to scour off grease, scale and roots. It cleans the full width of the pipe wall, which helps the line stay clear longer.
included: Camera check to confirm the pipe can take jetting
Flushing debris out to the sewer
signs: Grease buildup that cabling doesn't fix
Root intrusion in the sewer line

pages.name: Water Heater Repair & Replacement
pages.meta_title: Water Heater Repair & Replacement in Columbia, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Tank water heater repair and replacement for Columbia and the Midlands, SC. Gas and electric units, all makes and models, same-day replacement available.
pages.summary: Gas and electric, all makes and models, with same-day replacement available.
pages.intro_what: Your water heater runs every day, and sediment, worn parts and age eventually catch up with it. We repair what can be repaired and replace units that have reached the end of their life.
intro_signs: Hot water runs out faster than it used to
Rusty or discolored hot water
Rumbling or popping from the tank
Water around the base of the unit
pages.intro_expect: We check the unit, find the cause and tell you whether a repair or a replacement makes more sense for its age and condition. If you're replacing it, we install the new unit, connect it to code, and haul the old one away.

cards.title: Tank Water Heater Repair
cards.desc: Many problems come down to one worn part, like a thermostat, element, igniter or valve. We test the unit, replace the part that failed, and check that it's heating safely again.
signs: Pilot light that won't stay lit
Tripped breaker on an electric unit

cards.title: Tank Replacement
cards.desc: When a tank is leaking or worn out, replacement is the safe fix. We size the new unit to your household, install it to code and take the old one with us.
included: Removal and haul-away of the old unit
New supply, venting and valve connections
signs: Water leaking from the tank itself
Rust on the tank or in the water
A unit that needs repeated repairs

cards.title: Same-Day Replacement
cards.desc: Going without hot water is hard on any household. Same-day replacement is available, so in many cases you can have hot water back the same day you call.
included: Replacement unit sized to your home
signs: A tank that has started leaking

cards.title: Gas & Electric Units
cards.desc: We work on both natural gas and electric water heaters, all makes and models. Each has its own parts and safety checks, and we know both well.
included: Gas burner, pilot and venting checks
Gas line connection and leak test
signs: One element failing on an electric unit
Hot water that takes a long time to recover

cards.title: Annual Flush & Maintenance
cards.desc: Midlands water leaves sediment in the bottom of the tank, which makes the heater work harder and wear out sooner. A yearly flush and check helps the unit last.
signs: Rumbling or popping while the unit heats
No service in the past year

pages.name: Leak Detection
pages.meta_title: Leak Detection in Columbia & Irmo, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Electronic and camera leak detection for hidden slab, in-wall and supply line leaks in homes across Columbia, Irmo, Lexington and the Midlands, SC.
pages.summary: We find hidden leaks in slabs, walls and supply lines before they do real damage.
pages.intro_what: Leak detection finds water escaping where you can't see it: under a slab, inside a wall or along a buried line. Locating it precisely means we open only what's needed to make the repair.
intro_signs: A water bill that jumps without explanation
Warm spots on the floor
Damp drywall, peeling paint or musty smells
The water meter moving with everything turned off
pages.intro_expect: We start with a meter test to confirm there's a leak, then use electronic listening equipment and cameras to pinpoint it. You'll see where it is and what the repair involves before anything is opened up.

cards.title: Slab Leaks
cards.desc: A slab leak is a break in a water line that runs under your concrete floor. We pinpoint the spot so the repair is as small and clean as possible.
included: Electronic leak location through the slab
signs: Warm or damp spots on the floor
Sound of running water under the floor
High water bills with no visible leak

cards.title: In-Wall Leaks
cards.desc: Pipes inside walls can drip for months before you see a stain. We find the leak from the outside of the wall and open only the area we need to reach it.
included: Locating the leak inside the wall
signs: Stains or bubbling paint on walls

cards.title: Fixture & Supply Line Leaks
cards.desc: Supply lines and shutoff valves under sinks, toilets and appliances wear out over time. We find the drip and replace the worn line or valve before it lets go.
included: Checking supply lines and shutoff valves
Inspecting toilet, sink and appliance connections
signs: Water in the cabinet under a sink

cards.title: Electronic & Camera Location
cards.desc: Listening equipment picks up the sound of escaping water, and cameras let us look inside drain lines. Together they show where the problem is without guesswork.
included: A clear explanation of what we found
signs: You know there's a leak but can't find it
Water damage with no obvious source

pages.name: Sewer Services
pages.meta_title: Sewer Line Repair & Replacement in the Midlands, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Sewer line inspection, spot repairs, trenchless options and full sewer line replacement for homes in Columbia and the Midlands, SC.
pages.summary: Camera inspection, spot repairs, trenchless options and full sewer line replacement.
pages.intro_what: Your sewer line carries every drain in the house out to the city sewer or your septic tank. Roots, shifting soil and age can crack, sag or collapse it, and we inspect it, repair it, or replace it.
intro_signs: Repeated main line backups
Sewage smell in the yard or house
Soggy or sunken spots in the lawn
Drains that gurgle after flushing
pages.intro_expect: We start with a camera inspection to see the condition of the line and find the trouble spot. Then we walk you through the options, from a spot repair to a full replacement, and what each one involves for your yard.

cards.title: Sewer Line Inspection
cards.desc: An inspection shows the condition of your sewer line from the house to the street. It's the right first step before any repair, and smart when you're buying a home.
included: Camera inspection of the full line
Notes on roots, sags and cracks
Recommendations based on what we find
signs: Buying or selling an older home
Large trees near the sewer line

cards.title: Spot Repairs
cards.desc: When the damage is limited to one section, we repair just that section. It costs less and disturbs less of your yard than replacing the whole line.
signs: One crack or offset joint found on camera
Roots entering at a single joint

cards.title: Trenchless Options
cards.desc: Trenchless methods repair or replace a sewer line through small access points instead of a long open trench. When your line is a good fit, it saves your driveway, landscaping and lawn.
included: Camera check to confirm the line is a fit
Small access points instead of a full trench
Repair or replacement of the line
signs: Sewer line runs under a driveway or patio

cards.title: Full Line Replacement
cards.desc: When a sewer line is collapsed, badly sagged or failing in several places, replacing it is the lasting fix. We install new pipe from the house to the connection point.
included: New sewer pipe installed to code
signs: Collapsed or crushed pipe on camera
Old clay or cast iron pipe failing

pages.name: Gas Line Repair & Service
pages.meta_title: Gas Line Repair & Installation in Columbia, SC | Mr. Plumber, Inc.
pages.meta_description: Gas line installation, leak repair and pressure testing for natural gas and propane in homes across Columbia and the Midlands, SC. Done to code.
pages.summary: Installation, leak repair and pressure testing for natural gas and propane lines, done to code.
pages.intro_what: Gas lines feed your range, water heater, dryer, fireplace and other appliances. We install new lines, repair leaks and pressure test the system so it runs safely.
intro_signs: Smell of gas near an appliance or meter
Hissing sound near a gas line
Adding a gas range, dryer or water heater
Yellow or uneven burner flames
pages.intro_expect: If you smell gas, leave the house first and call your gas utility, then call us for the repair. For planned work, we look at where the line needs to go, install or repair it to code, and pressure test before anything is turned back on.

cards.title: New Gas Lines & Appliance Hookups
cards.desc: Adding a gas range, dryer, water heater or fireplace means running a new line from the existing supply. We size and route it properly and connect the appliance safely.
included: Planning the line route and size
signs: Switching from electric to gas appliances
Adding a fireplace or outdoor kitchen

cards.title: Gas Leak Repair
cards.desc: A gas leak is a safety problem that needs a professional repair. We find the leak, repair or replace the fitting or section of pipe, and test before restoring service.
included: Repairing or replacing fittings and pipe
Pressure test of the repaired line
signs: Rotten egg smell indoors or near the meter
Dead patch of grass over a buried line

cards.title: Pressure Testing
cards.desc: A pressure test confirms a gas system holds tight with no leaks. It's often required after new work, during remodels, or before service is turned on.
